description: This file defines a templated SocketServerType class within the Thunder::Core namespace, which manages socket-based client connections, including handling, iteration, and communication with clients. It includes nested classes for client iteration and socket handling, and provides methods for opening, closing, submitting data, and managing clients.

classes.name: SocketServerType
classes.description: A templated class managing socket client connections, including client iteration, handling, and communication.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A nested class providing iteration over connected clients.

classes.name: SocketHandler
classes.description: A nested class managing socket listening, accepting new clients, and client management.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the socket server to start listening for connections.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket server and disconnects clients.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up closed or suspended clients.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Retrieves a client proxy by ID.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a client connection by ID.

methods.name: LocalNode
methods.description: Sets the local node ID for the socket server.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a package to a client identified by ID.

methods.name: Clients
methods.description: Returns an iterator over current clients.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of connected clients.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the internal client management for thread safety.
